validity.population: synthetic homogeneous receptor population on one representative cell

validity.description: Deterministic one-to-one mass-action binding under prescribed piecewise-constant external ligand concentrations.

limitations: All kinetic, concentration, volume, receptor, threshold, and pulse values are synthetic software-test parameters.
The prescribed ligand trajectory is an external reservoir and is not depleted by receptor binding.
Concentration is homogeneous inside each time segment and changes discontinuously at declared knots.
The model is deterministic and excludes molecule-count noise and cell-to-cell variability.
There is no receptor synthesis, degradation, internalization, recycling, cooperativity, competition, or spatial transport.
Threshold crossing is a software event and does not yet change intracellular or higher-layer state.
Fixed-step RK4 is verified only inside the declared rate-step bound and is not an adaptive stiff solver.
